_comment: In-app purchases to create in App Store Connect. Product ids must match AppInfo.swift's productIDs and App/Products.storekit exactly, or the paywall shows nothing in the real build. Create with: node tools/asc/iap.mjs quizday --apply

products.name: Quizday Pro Weekly
products.description: Practice any category as much as you like, at easy, medium or hard, with your accuracy broken down by category. The daily ten stays free.
products.reviewNote: Unlocks the Practice tab. The daily ten-question round is free and unaffected.

products.name: Quizday Pro Yearly
products.description: A year of practice: any category, any difficulty, with per-category accuracy so you can see what you are weakest at. The daily ten stays free.
products.reviewNote: Unlocks the Practice tab. The daily ten-question round is free and unaffected.
